page.layout: One column of running text, set in italic type with roman lines for the verse quotation. Running head at the top right. Page number at the top right. Catchword at the lower right and a gathering signature mark at the lower left of the text block. No marginal notes.

p.i: Scelus publici partus, omni honore pontificio spoliata, sine pompa papali sepulta erat. Cuius in Alphonso[?] mentionem Mantuanus lib. 3. facit, inferos describens:
Hic pendebat adhuc, sexum mentita uirilem Fœminae, cui triplici Phrygiam diademate mitram Extollebat[?] apex, & pontificalis adulter.

main_text.p: In hoc poteris uidere, pie lector, qualiter Ecclesia Romana post missam de spiritu sancto, non potuit errare. Hoc factum reuera, meretricis magnae sedem, & omnium fornicationum matrem, ipsam clarius esse demonstrat, quam ullus unquam Apelles coloribus depingere queat.
Vt vero pontifices & uncti patres, id facimus detestari uideantur, ab ea platea declinant, tanquam a loco de malo omine ualde suspecto.

Functius[?] non dubitat, quin diuinitus fit permissum, ut haec fœmina fieret pontifex, & eadem meretrix, cum eo tempore subderet sibi reges (quales in Anglia Ethelwuolphus & Alphredus erant) ut Antichristum regem agnosceret.
Voluit namque tunc Deus in Papa meretrice, Babylonicum fornicum, de quo praedixerat Spiritus sanctus Apoc. 17, mundo manifestare, ut ab illo electi cauerent.
Sed ne in posterum, in similem casum inciderent patres, ordinauerunt, ut electi pontifices genitalia per sedem perforatam a diacono attrectarentur.

page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment of a longer word ("Scelus") and is printed with a long s, transcribed as s. "Alphonso" is split across two lines ("Al" / "phonso") and is marked as doubtful. "Extollebat" has a damaged ligature and is marked. "Functius" is doubtful. The catchword at the foot is cut off at the scan edge and is marked as doubtful. The mark at the foot left is a gathering signature "H". A small stray mark at the very bottom of the page is not printed text and is left out. The last line of text ends with a printed hyphen ("attre-"), which is kept.
